description: This file defines the ContentDao interface, which declares methods for accessing and managing content entities within the application. It includes method signatures for listing, retrieving, and querying content based on various parameters such as type, store, language, code, and URL.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a specific ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a list of ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its unique code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code within a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a single ContentType and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a list of ContentType and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects for specified content types, store, and language, excluding non-visible content.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its ID and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
